conflicts.title: The slides are an onboarding deck, but the meeting is sprint planning
conflicts.description: The deck presented is 'Welcome to Project Atlas', a new team member onboarding deck, while the discussion is Sprint 14 planning. Nothing said refers to the slides.

positions.statement: Welcome to Project Atlas: new team member onboarding.
Let's get started with sprint planning. This is sprint 14.

conflicts.title: Whether to pull the full PDF export into the sprint
conflicts.description: One participant suggested adding the PDF export to use the remaining capacity; another said its 8 points would take the sprint over velocity and leave no buffer for bugs.

positions.statement: We're at 13 points with velocity around 20, so there's room to pull in the PDF export.
The export is about 8 points, which puts us over. Better to leave buffer for bugs.

conflicts.resolution: Only the basic PDF layout (3 points) is in the sprint, for 16 points in total.
